Innovating at the Intersection of Physics, Data Science, and Research Operations

🚀 At Oura, I lead research operations, unlocking scalable data collection for next-gen health sensing. My team drives groundbreaking research, from internal studies to external collaborations, leading to scientific publications and validating Oura’s capabilities in health sensing.

🧠 Before Oura, I earned my PhD in Applied Physics at Harvard, co-founding the iconic Science & Cooking course. Fascinated by the quantified self movement, I joined Fitbit, building business intelligence and data science systems. Later, as an early member of Indigo Ag’s Innovation Team, I helped shape what is now their carbon credits program. I love building teams of curious, ambitious people to tackle complex problems.

🏋️‍♂️ Outside work, you’ll find me at 5:30 AM CrossFit, chasing PRs, or running weekend half-marathons. I’m an avid reader, a scientific cook, and endlessly curious about the intersection of physics, psychology, randomness, and human performance.

All opinions are my own and not reflective of Oura or previous employers.
